Your personal tracker. Progress is saved on this device.

Two messages per post, because WhatsApp trims text attached to an image.
1. Share card sends the picture. That is message one.
2. Copy caption, then paste it as a separate message. That keeps the full text and all links.
Then Mark as posted.
Reset all

On a computer, use Copy image then paste into WhatsApp Web, then Copy caption and paste as the next message. Mark as posted only after it has gone out.
